Usage: <LAB>/.lab-runs/a-collision-uninstall/.specify/scripts/python/create_new_feature.py [--json] [--dry-run] [--allow-existing-branch] [--short-name <name>] [--number N] [--timestamp] <feature_description>

Options:
  --json              Output in JSON format
  --dry-run           Compute feature name and paths without creating directories or files
  --allow-existing-branch  Reuse an existing feature directory if it already exists
  --short-name <name> Provide a custom short name (2-4 words) for the feature
  --number N          Prefer a feature number (auto-corrected if its specs prefix exists)
  --timestamp         Use timestamp prefix (YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS) instead of sequential numbering
  --help, -h          Show this help message

Examples:
  <LAB>/.lab-runs/a-collision-uninstall/.specify/scripts/python/create_new_feature.py 'Add user authentication system' --short-name 'user-auth'
  <LAB>/.lab-runs/a-collision-uninstall/.specify/scripts/python/create_new_feature.py 'Implement OAuth2 integration for API' --number 5
  <LAB>/.lab-runs/a-collision-uninstall/.specify/scripts/python/create_new_feature.py --timestamp --short-name 'user-auth' 'Add user authentication'
